offers_products.reason: Sells curriculum and software platforms (K12 Learning Hub, Tallo) and learning materials to schools; products are among main offerings.

offers_services.reason: Operates online public schools, tutoring and career learning programs; school management and instruction are core services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Private schools, tutoring and Learning Hub are chosen by families and students; online public school enrollment is family-chosen.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Public schools are paid by school districts and states; it contracts with schools and enterprises for learning solutions.

recurring_revenue.reason: Students enroll in full-time online schools year after year, funded per-student; ongoing enrollment and tutoring subscriptions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Public school enrollment is funded by government per student; education is non-discretionary and not easily cut in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Families do not pay directly for public schools; revenue is per-student funding spread over the school year, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value is teaching by certified teachers and tutors in online schools, though curriculum technology also matters.

large_customers.reason: Largest part of revenue comes from state-funded public schools and districts, which are government entities.

asset_heavy.reason: Fully remote online schooling delivered through software and teachers; no plants, fleets or property-heavy operations.

notes: Public school revenue is paid by government, but families choose enrollment, so both buyer types are marked yes.
